compute_elementwise_integer_power: compute the element-wise integer power of a Crypten tensor using the pow function
approximate_noninteger_power: approximate a non-integer power of a positive-valued Crypten tensor using pos_pow via exp and log
evaluate_polynomial_on_tensor: evaluate a polynomial with given coefficients on a Crypten tensor using the polynomial function
compute_p_norm: compute the p-norm of a Crypten tensor for p values 1, 2, fro, or infinity
compute_dimensional_norm: compute the p-norm of a Crypten tensor along a specified dimension with optional keepdim
